svg.title: Tidal Gate Causeway — A broad tidal lock and shell-carved admission quay
svg.desc: A dry admission quay spans the tidal lock. A shell-carved arch, bronze floodgate and cargo crane frame Nacre’s turning space; kelp rigging reaches the upper inspection deck.
svg.text: A broad tidal lock and shell-carved admission quay
A dry admission quay spans the tidal lock. A shell-carved arch, bronze floodgate and cargo crane frame Nacre’s
turning space; kelp rigging reaches the upper inspection deck.
Shell · kelp rope · sea glass · driftwood · verdigris bronze
P1 Gatehall of Shells · P2 Tidal Lagoon
